title: a-proofs-isolation-holds-however-it-is-invoked
intention: A proof's isolation holds however it is invoked: no proof run by a CC tool call or by codemother's verdict writes into live ~/.cairn.
why: Measured 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs write live ~/.cairn when run outside the tester's seal (2705 paths), a CC session's hand run leaked 6 inference tickets, and codemother's verdict runs proofs bare at every PROVED. The lived symptom: the operator's live logs, trouble lanes and launcher pid files carry fixture writes nobody can tell from real ones. The seal is the single door; the hands that bypass it are refused or routed through it.
traces_to: Law 8 and Law 4: the seal is the one door, held by physics. the strace census harness (scratchpad census_pytest_writes.py, 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs wrote 2705 paths into live ~/.cairn under raw pytest; one CC session's python3 run of e9a2's proof leaked 6 inference tickets).
how: Children: 1af0564c0db3 (bin: rewrite python3 proof runs under the seal and refuse pytest at PreToolUse), 2c9eeab2da87 (tester: publish a sealed exec), 68cef2ddd8ef (codemother verdict: run instruments through it). No conftest: nothing in the repo uses pytest (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py line 9), and CC's pytest hand is 1af0564c0db3's.

out: bin/cmd/proofgate: a convenience that rewrites the common spelling, no longer the seal (Q#101, open-49fc67a40ede)

measured.saw: fixture proof writing $HOME/.cairn/leak/<spelling>: xargs gate=pass writes ['xargs']; heredoc gate=rewrite writes []; script gate=pass writes ['script']
measured.how: scratchpad census.py on akienasus: proofgate.judge per spelling, the returned command run by bash under a scratch HOME

measured.saw: proofgate.judge returns None for `ssh akiendelllinux '... python3 <proof>'` and for `ssh ... bash -lc 'python3 <proof>'`: an ssh-wrapped proof run is invisible to the text gate
measured.how: orchestrator, proofgate.judge over the two spellings

measured.saw: the 11-16 00:57 MST fixture folders (testing-5bcb-slow 00:57:17, testing-c203-mutual-a 00:57:43, testing-ee88c2126abc-x 00:57:49, testing-a1d2-x 00:57:53) came from SEALED tester runs, not a bare hand: runs test-583145bce4fb and test-1baa6e9786d8 (07:56:36-07:56:59Z, akienasus q75 reseal/walk) recorded the bus serving with HOME=/home/akien; the bus is spawned by `systemd-run --user` (remote.py:233), whose unit runs outside bwrap's --bind of ~/.cairn. The only akienasus ssh login in the window (00:57:32) lasted <1 s; akienasus's raw ssh proof runs (11-14 08:12Z, 09:54Z; 11-16 05:50-05:51Z) ran no bus proof and match no fixture time; the 11-12 19:49 window has no akienasus proof run on the Dell
measured.how: bus-bounces.jsonl under ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0/runs/<id>/sealed (fields home, test); last_known.json mtimes; Dell journalctl sshd; akienasus transcript tool calls in both windows; grep systemd-run in cairn/tools

measured.saw: inside `bin/cairn test --exec` on akiendelllinux: live ~/.cairn dev=66306 ino=29109833; sealed ~/.cairn dev=50; `systemd-run --user --wait --pipe stat ~/.cairn` from inside the seal reads dev=66306 ino=29109833 (the live tree); `setsid -w stat ~/.cairn` reads dev=50 (the swap). A systemd-run unit escapes the seal; a setsid child stays in it.
measured.how: orchestrator, stat of ~/.cairn from a sealed exec, direct and through each spawn spelling

outcomes.claim: every per-proof command of the census harness typed as a CC Bash command is refused (pytest) or rewritten to run under the seal (python3), never run bare (discharged: 1af0564c0db3 PROVED)
the census harness re-run through `cairn test --exec` over the censused proofs records 0 writes into live ~/.cairn (discharged: 2c9eeab2da87 PROVED)
a verdict run of a chart instrument executes sealed (discharged: 68cef2ddd8ef PROVED)

no proof run writes live ~/.cairn: running the bus proofs that make fixture devices (test_a_wake_never_waits_under_the_hold_lock, test_mail_in_delivery_is_never_bounced, test_a_gone_clients_request_is_not_run) under `bin/cairn test --seal`, and the same proof as a bare `python3 <proof>` (no tester seal), leaves the live ~/.cairn/devices listing (names + mtimes) byte-identical before and after; the bare run refuses before its first tooth

outcomes.text: D5: a proof refuses to run outside the tester's seal: the scratch door (cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py, which the fixture proofs already enter) raises a named refusal when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is absent and the process is not under a sealed swap (isolation.sealed). One check, no spelling enumerated (outline 9.4.2.5.1, Q#101 / open-49fc67a40ede answer (a)).

D6: a process a sealed run spawns stays in the seal: when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set, cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py (bus spawn) and cairn/tools/base/shim.py:199 (loop spawn) start the child with setsid inside the run, not via `systemd-run --user`, whose unit the user manager starts OUTSIDE bwrap's mount namespace and so sees the live ~/.cairn (measured 2026-11-18: systemd-run child dev=66306 = live, setsid child dev=50 = swap). Bounds: only the two spawn sites, remote.py:233 and shim.py:199. Its tooth: inside a sealed run, the scratch bus process's ~/.cairn stat carries the swap's st_dev, not the live one.

D7: the proof bin/proofs/test_a_proof_run_by_any_spelling_is_sealed.py measures outcome 4 under a scratch commons: listing of live ~/.cairn/devices before/after a sealed run and a bare run of one fixture bus proof; teeth: sealed run adds nothing; bare run refuses and adds nothing. A further tooth for D6: a sealed run spawns a scratch bus, and the bus process's view of ~/.cairn (stat via /proc/<pid>/root or the bus reporting os.stat) has st_dev equal to the run's own ~/.cairn st_dev and unequal to the live one.

D8: HYPOTHESIS (outline 0.6.1, CC's answer, not a question): On Windows there is no bwrap seal; the tester's scratch-HOME path (d95796cdfb9b: HOME/USERPROFILE point at a per-run scratch dir) is the seal there, so D5's check counts a run as sealed when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set and Path.home() resolves under that run's scratch dir; with no systemd-run on Windows, D6 is a no-op there. WATCHME(windows_proof_runs_stay_off_live_cairn): trigger each `cairn test --seal` batch on a Windows box; enough 10 batches with 0 new or touched entries under the live %USERPROFILE%\.cairn\devices, or the first nonzero (kills the hypothesis); carrier a verdict against outcome 4 on Windows: before/after listing of live .cairn\devices; consumer cc_0.
